name: Postupivshij v PTUTI
source:
A short story about a young man who entered the first year of an institute called "PTUTI".

Every day struggling with his complexes, tightness and mental disorders - the main character tries to overcome all obstacles and live a normal student life. He has to fight his inner introvert and go out into society.

What might a first-year tech student be thinking about? Games, friends, handing in practical work, and, of course, girls. Real girls.

The hero meets two ambiguous heroines on his way.

Katya is a gopnitsa with a 4th breast size. At first glance, an aggressive and unbalanced personality.

He likes to eat borscht with cabbage pies in the university cafeteria, he protects his girlfriend from suspicious guys. That is, from all the guys. Even despite the fact that she herself often wears off in the company of boys dressed in adidas.

Mila is a cute girl with blue hair who dresses like a goth. At first glance, you might think that she is one of those

who walks in the night in cemeteries. He likes to listen to Hard Metal, King and Jester and play computer games. Timid and shy, but friendly at the same time.

Masha - ???

The protagonist is a hikkan and an otaku with mental disabilities. Skinny, locked in. During school days, he was bullied by peers. Sees the whole world in black and white

Suffers from hallucinations and panic attacks.

How to survive in a world that rejects you?

[From [url=https://muranof.itch.io/enrolled-ptuti]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个关于一个年轻人进入名为“PTUTI”的学院一年级的短篇故事。

每天都在与自己的情结、紧张和精神障碍作斗争——主角试图克服一切障碍，过上正常的学生生活。他必须与内心的内向作斗争，走向社会。

科技专业一年级学生可能会想什么？游戏、朋友、交作业，当然还有女孩。真正的女孩。

男主角在途中遇到了两个暧昧的女主角。

Katya是一个拥有第四个乳房大小的gopnitsa。乍一看，性格咄咄逼人、不平衡。

他喜欢在大学食堂吃罗宋汤和卷心菜馅饼，他保护女友免受可疑人物的侵害。也就是说，来自所有的人。尽管事实上她自己经常在穿着阿迪达斯的男孩的陪伴下疲惫不堪。

米拉是一个可爱的女孩，有着蓝色的头发，穿着像哥特。乍一看，你可能会认为她就是其中之一

谁在夜里在墓地里行走。他喜欢听Hard Metal、King和Jester以及玩电脑游戏。胆怯、害羞，但同时又友善。

玛莎-？？？

主角是一名北汉，也是一名患有精神障碍的御宅族。瘦弱、封闭。在学生时代，他受到同龄人的欺负。用黑白的方式看整个世界

患有幻觉和惊恐发作。

如何在一个拒绝你的世界中生存？

[来自[url=https://muranof.itch.io/enrolled-ptuti]Itch.io[/url]]
